title: Expectation under a product law
statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability mass functions on $A$ and $B$, respectively, and let $f:A	imes B	o\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under the product law that samples independently from $\mu$ and $
u$ equals the expectation over $a\sim\mu$ of the expectation over $b\sim
u$ of $f(a,b)$.
